title: Se-Jong

symbol.name: Se-Jong
symbol.meaning: King Sejong the Great · ITF pattern 23 of 24

note.p: Se-Jong is named after Sejong the Great, the greatest Korean king, who created the Korean alphabet in 1443 and was also a noted meteorologist. The diagram 王 stands for the king, and the 24 movements for the 24 letters of the Korean alphabet. You start in close ready stance B in the middle of the A–B line facing D: a low block to B, a twin forearm block toward A and a side kick toward D; a rising block and knife-hand strike on the E–F line; a jump into X-stance onto the G–H line, with a punch, a high guarding block in fixed stance, a fingertip thrust and a back fist; a scooping block, turning kick and jump back onto the E–F line; slow fist extension and back fist in sitting stance, palm and arc-hand blocks, one-leg blocks and a back forearm strike; then a side elbow thrust, a guarding block and a punch back on the A–B line.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (24 movements, one technique each). The three lines of the 王 are the A–B line with the start (top), the E–F line (middle) and the G–H line (bottom). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and G are on the A side, F and H on the B side; DG, CF and CE are diagonals. Finish by bringing the left foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in close ready stance B.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a left walking stance facing B. Left forearm low block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Twin forearm block.
Right middle side piercing kick toward D.
Lower the right foot toward D, then move the left foot to F into a left walking stance facing F. Left forearm rising block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot, then move the right foot to E into a sitting stance facing D. Right knife-hand middle strike toward E.
Bring the right foot to the left foot into close ready stance B facing D.
Jump toward D, landing in a left X-stance facing DG. Left back fist high side strike toward D, the right fingertips on the left side fist.
Move the right foot to G into a right walking stance facing G. Right high punch.
Move the right foot along the G–H line into a left fixed stance facing H (left foot forward). Forearm high guarding block.
Move the right foot to H into a right walking stance facing H. Right straight fingertip middle thrust.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot to G into a left walking stance facing G. Left back fist high side strike.
Move the left foot along the G–H line into a sitting stance facing C. Left palm scooping block.
Left middle turning kick toward C.
Land the left foot toward C with a jump, into a left X-stance facing CF. Left double forearm high block toward C.
Move the right foot to F into a sitting stance facing C, extending the right fist straight out toward C, slowly.
In the same stance, left back fist front strike toward C.
Bring the right foot behind the left foot, then move the left foot to E into a left diagonal stance facing C. Twin palm pressing block.
Turn into a left walking stance facing CE. Double arc-hand middle block toward C.
Pull the left reverse footsword up to the right knee joint into a right one-leg stance facing C. Right outer forearm high side block toward F and left forearm low side block toward E.
Lower the left foot toward D into a right walking stance facing C. Right palm pressing block, slowly.
Pull the left instep into the hollow of the right knee into a right one-leg stance facing C. Right back forearm strike into the left palm.
Lower the left foot toward C, turning clockwise into a right fixed stance facing D (right foot forward). Left side elbow thrust toward C.
Move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand high guarding block.
Bring the right foot to the left foot, then move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right middle punch.
